title: Fantastic, most inclusive app but a few improvements need to be made
body:
- The "total count" of habit completion is literally a total count of how many times you've completed the habit. It really needs to be a streak feature like nearly all other habit apps. 
- habits need the ability to add a description to them. 
- unlimited checks on habits would be great. For example, if you complete the habit more than what you've set it to in the app you can't record this
- sub habits would also be a cool feature
- you are unable to see past events from synced calendars. This is the most ridiculous downside of the app and I've never seen another app do this. 
- the mobile app is a bit confusing design wise. The iPad and Mac apps on the other hand are amazing. 
- "dark mode" support would be a real bonus

title: Going backwards - cannot currently recommend
body:
I am a very experienced and long-term GTD to-do app user and I have used almost all the platforms out there.

This is the second time I have updated this review and sadly I am downgrading my rating of this app substantially.

The TickTick folk seem to be overwhelmed with the app's success and unable to keep up. Their responsiveness to support enquiries has dropped off badly.

Worst of all, background sync has become a universal problem with the app - previously it was best-in-class. Numerous users complain of this and nothing has been done to address it for months now.

Compared to other to-do and GTD apps, functionality is fairly powerful and usability is pretty good, once you get used to its quirky approach.

Lack of sub-projects is a shame, with the checklist option per task only a partial solution. And a limited set of annoying reminder sounds is ... annoying!

I would love to recommend this app, but cannot until they sort out some fundamental problems, especially background sync between platforms.
